settings.heading: Journal
settings.lede: Field notes on cookware, careful use, and the ideas behind Maison Tavo.

settings.heading: A vessel for everyday heat
settings.text: A useful pan earns its place through ordinary meals. We study shape, weight, and heat response alongside the rituals cooks return to each day.

settings.heading: Reading the heat
settings.text: The colour of oil, the sound of a simmer, and the moment food releases from a surface are practical signals. Our heat study explores how vessel construction can support that judgement.

settings.heading: Care is part of the object
settings.text: Cleaning, drying, and storing cookware are part of its design life. Visit the care guide for steps suited to each material and finish.
